name: Scenic-Or-Not: Scenic Beauty Ratings
description: Faithful replication of the Scenic-Or-Not rating task used by Seresinhe, Preis & Moat (2017, Royal Society Open Science): random geotagged photographs of Great Britain from Geograph, each rated on an integer scale from 1 (not scenic) to 10 (very scenic). The 82 images are real Scenic-Or-Not photographs (Geograph contributors, CC BY-SA 2.0; file names hold the Geograph photo id, where each photographer is credited), chosen across the whole range of crowd ratings. Differences from the original study: (1) 82 images instead of 217,000; (2) each participant rates 30 random images rather than as many as they like; (3) a short About-you page was added.
author: Seresinhe, Preis & Moat
